segments.an10.4:1.1: [a. ni.11.4] Tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.an10.4:1.3: avippaṭisāre asati avippaṭisāravipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti … pe … vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
segments.an10.4:1.5: Seyyathāpi, āvuso, rukkho sākhāpalāsavipanno. Tassa papaṭikāpi na pāripūriṃ gacchati, tacopi … pheggupi … sāropi na pāripūriṃ gacchati.
segments.an10.4:1.6: Evamevaṃ kho, āvuso, dussīlassa sīlavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti avippaṭisāro;
segments.an10.4:1.7: avippaṭisāre asati avippaṭisāravipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti … pe … vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
segments.an10.4:2.2: avippaṭisāre sati avippaṭisārasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti … pe.
segments.an10.4:2.4: Seyyathāpi, āvuso, rukkho sākhāpalāsasampanno. Tassa papaṭikāpi pāripūriṃ gacchati, tacopi … pheggupi … sāropi pāripūriṃ gacchati.
segments.an10.4:2.5: Evamevaṃ kho, āvuso, sīlavato sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti avippaṭisāro;
segments.an10.4:2.6: avippaṭisāre sati avippaṭisārasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti … pe … vimuttiñāṇadassanan”ti.
